surface-000.$description: Page background. Midnight is the default theme; Daylight is the light alternative.

surface-100.$description: Cards, panels, app bar, list rows: anything that sits on the page and carries an edge and hard shadow.

surface-200.$description: Insets inside a card: poster placeholders, chips, input wells.

edge.$description: The 2.5px outline on every card, button, chip and input. In Midnight it reads as a soft dark rim; in Daylight it is the crisp ink line from the logo.

hairline.$description: Dividers inside a card (between list rows, under the app bar). Never an outline for a component.

text-primary.$description: Headlines and body text on surface-000/100/200.

text-secondary.$description: Meta lines (year, runtime, director), labels, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

brand.$description: Bottle green, taken from the logo badge. Secondary buttons, poster tints, and the hard shadow under cards. Text on it: on-brand.

brand-soft.$description: The logo's stripe green. Selected chip fill, active nav underline, hover tint on brand. Text on it: on-brand.

accent.$description: Moon amber, taken from the logo. The one warm spark: primary button, filled rating stars, the current-year chip. Use it once or twice per screen.

cream.$description: The cat's fur from the logo. Highlights and illustration only; on Midnight it can carry large display text.

blush.$description: The cat's cheeks. A tiny decorative accent (a 'new' dot, a heart on a favourite); never for text or for state.

cat-ink.$description: The cat's eyes and lids, from the logo. Mascot only.

star-off.$description: Empty rating star fill. Stars always carry an edge-coloured stroke so they read at 3:1.

focus.$description: 3px focus ring, offset 3px, on every interactive element.

danger.$description: Error text and the outline of an invalid input. Only for errors.

space-6.$description: Gap between poster and details; between sections in a card.

radius-md.$description: Row thumbnails, inputs that are not pills.

border-edge.$description: The outline on cards, buttons, chips, inputs, posters.

shadow-card.$description: Every card and list row: a bottle-green block offset down-right.

shadow-hero.$description: The one large card on a page (film header).

shadow-control.$description: Buttons, posters and small raised things: an edge-coloured block.

shadow-pressed.$description: Pressed button: the shadow collapses as the button moves 3px down-right.
